sloka: क्रोधताम्रेक्षणो वीरो निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा।राघवो राक्षसं रोषादभिदुद्राव वेगितः।यूथपान् हर्षयन् सर्वान् कुम्भकर्णभयार्दितान् ।। ६.६७.१२२ ।।
transliteration: krodhatāmrekṣaṇo vīro nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā।rāghavo rākṣasaṁ roṣādabhidudrāva vegitaḥ।yūthapān harṣayan sarvān kumbhakarṇabhayārditān ।। 6.67.122 ।।

translations.english: All his weapons scattered on the ground, the mighty Kumbhakarna deprived of weapons thought for himself and created havoc with his feet and fists.
